ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)

   B. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   D. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.

   A. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   C. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   C. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   B. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   C. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

13. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.

----
